name: Malmark — MyAnimeList episode tracker
shortDescription: Track anime on Crunchyroll and confirm MyAnimeList updates. Add other websites yourself with the element picker.
firefoxSummary: Keep your MyAnimeList progress in step with Crunchyroll. Review episode updates in a sidebar, match seasons manually, and optionally add your own websites.
singlePurpose: Help users track anime episodes they watch and approve updates to their own MyAnimeList list.
